inputs.name: reviewCleanCode.input
inputs.description: Supplies a resolvable repository root and required clean-code settings for file discovery and review. Optional options control dry-run or cancellation, findings add snapshot context, and a supplied evaluator replaces the lazy Jev adapter; per-file failures become incomplete results, while discovery or final freshness-check failures can reject.

outputs.name: reviewCleanCode
outputs.description: Resolves to a report with the input mode, model and confidence threshold, rubric version, discovered-file coverage, per-file results, and token usage summed over noncached reviews. Dry runs return status `dry-run` without evaluating files; other runs derive status from file results, and errors outside per-file handling can reject the promise.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise may reject on root resolution, audited-file collection or discovery, or the final source/context freshness check, which occur outside the per-file catch. Snapshot or evaluator failures within an individual review are caught and represented as an `incomplete` file result.
